plugins.name: soleon
plugins.description: Connects Claude Code to Soleon: read, build, test, deploy and release agents. Consents to the whole Soleon surface; the server shows and allows only what your Soleon permissions permit. Includes create-agent, deploy-agent (identity markdown → Allium spec → validated agent), pull-agent (a Soleon agent as a local subagent whose every save lands on your draft), run-local-eval, write-evals and write-skill-scripts.
